summary: Quick start cable setup guide for the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder covering Stick, MIG, Flux, and TIG welding configurations.
text_content:
VULCAN OMNIPRO 220 QUICK START GUIDE 57812

STICK CABLE SETUP
1. Connect ground clamp to negative terminal.
2. Connect electrode holder to positive terminal.
3. Leave wire feed power disconnected.

MIG CABLE SETUP
1. Connect ground clamp to negative terminal.
2. Connect wire feed power to positive terminal.
3. Connect MIG gun to wire feed.
4. Connect wire feed control inside welder.

FLUX CABLE SETUP
Follow MIG cable setup but connect ground clamp to positive terminal and wire feed power to negative terminal.

TIG CABLE SETUP
1. Connect ground clamp to positive terminal.
2. Connect TIG torch to negative terminal.
3. Connect gas line to gas regulator.
4. Connect foot pedal inside welder.
5. Leave wire feed power disconnected.

BASIC WELDING INSTRUCTIONS AND WELDING TIPS ARE IN MANUAL.

key_facts: Product model: Vulcan OmniPro 220, item number 57812
Stick welding: ground clamp connects to negative terminal
Stick welding: electrode holder connects to positive terminal
Stick welding: wire feed power must be left disconnected
MIG welding: ground clamp connects to negative terminal
MIG welding: wire feed power connects to positive terminal
MIG welding: MIG gun connects to wire feed
MIG welding: wire feed control connects inside welder
Flux-cored welding: uses same physical setup as MIG but with reversed polarity
Flux-cored welding: ground clamp connects to positive terminal
Flux-cored welding: wire feed power connects to negative terminal
TIG welding: ground clamp connects to positive terminal
TIG welding: TIG torch connects to negative terminal
TIG welding: gas line connects to gas regulator
TIG welding: foot pedal connects inside welder
TIG welding: wire feed power must be left disconnected
MIG polarity: DCEP (electrode positive)
Flux-cored polarity: DCEN (electrode negative)
TIG polarity: DCEP for ground, DCEN for torch (standard DCEN TIG setup)
Stick polarity: DCEP (electrode positive)
